verses.text: Ayik ayoch heb' juez yajalil t'a chonhab' Israel, ix jawi jun niwan wejel t'a chonhab' chi'. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay jun winh aj chonhab' Belén t'a yol yik Judá, ix b'at kajnaj winh yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' chawanh yuninal t'a yol yik Moab yuj jun wejel chi'.

Ha jun winh chi', Elimelec sb'i winh, haxo ix yetb'eyum winh, Noemí sb'i ix. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh chi', haton winhaj Mahlón yet' winhaj Quelión. Aj Efrata heb', Belén pax sb'i. Ix b'atkan kajan heb' t'a yol yik Moab chi'. Lajunhe' ab'il ix ek' heb' ta'. Yakb'an ayek' heb' chi' ta', ix cham winhaj Elimelec yetb'eyum ix Noemí chi', ix kan ix yet' chawanh heb' winh yune' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix och yetb'eyum heb' winh schawanhil. Ix yik'laj sb'a heb' winh yet' chawanh heb' ix aj Moab chi', jun ix skuch Orfa, haxo junxo ix skuch Rut.
Haxo ix aji, ix champax winhaj Mahlón yet' winhaj Quelión chi', yuj chi' ix kan ix Noemí sch'okoj, yujto ix cham heb' winh yune' ix chi', ix champax winh yetb'eyum ix.
Haxo ix yab'an ix Noemí chi' to ix ok'xi sk'ool Jehová t'a chonhab' Israel, manhxalaj wejel ta'.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj ix t'a Judá yet' chawanh heb' ix yalib' chi'.

Ayik wan skot heb' ix t'a yoltak b'e, ix yalan ix t'a heb' ix yalib' chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, paxanhek t'a spat he mam he nun. Ha Jehová ol och heyet'ok yujto wach'nhej ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin yet' t'a heb' winh wune'.
Aokab' Jehová ol och heyet'ok yik ol ochxok eyetb'eyum, wach'nhej ol aj eyajxiek' t'a he pat, xchi ix. Ix tz'ub'anelta sti' heb' ix yalib' ix chi', ix syamanoch heb' ix yoq'ui.
Ix yalan heb' ix icha tik: --Max onh kanlaj. Ol onh b'at het'ok t'a a chonhab' chi', xchi heb' ix.
Ix yalanxi ix t'a heb' ix: --Ex walib', paxanhek t'a he pat. ¿Tasto wal yuj tzex och tzak'an wuuj? Malaj wune' toxo tz'aji yik tzeyik'lan he b'a yet'ok.
Yuj chi' ixikek, paxanhek t'a he pat. Yujto a in tik, chichim inxo, manhxo ol ochlaj wetb'eyum. Wach'chom swal tiknaik to ha t'a jun ak'wal tik ol och wetb'eyum, olto aljok wune', ta xin chi,

¿palta tom olto he tanhwej sq'uib' heb' winh, yik ol eyik'an he b'a yet' heb' winh? ¿Tom yujnhej he tanhwani, manhxo ol och eyetb'eyum? Maay ex walib', manh ol yal-laj icha chi'. Ha in tik, wiktaxon yaj yaelal ix yak'kot Jehová t'a wib'anh. Ol am in te kus eyuuj tato ol wila'' to ol eyab' syail, xchi ix t'a heb' ix yalib' chi'.
Ix ochxi ijan heb' ix yoq'ui. Ixlajwi chi', haxo ix Orfa ix tz'ub'ankanelta sti' ix, ix meltzaj ix. Haxo pax ix Rut jun, ix kannhej ix yet' ix.
Ix yalanxi ix Noemí chi' t'a ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Tzam ila' to a ix a mu' toxo ix pax ix t'a schonhab' yet' t'a sdiosal, ixik pax a ach tik, xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Manh ach och ijan halan t'ayin yik tzach waktejkani. Yalnhej b'aj ol ach b'atok, ol in b'atnhej het'ok. Ha b'aj ol ach ajok, hata' ol in aj pax het'ok. Ha a chonhab', a ol och in chonhab'ok, a a Diosal, a ol ochpax in Diosalok.
Ha b'aj ol ach chamok, hata' ol in champaxok, hata' ol in muknajok. Yak'okab' in yaelal Jehová tato tzach waktejkani, masanto a chamel ol ik'an ko pojan ko b'a, xchi ix Rut chi'.
Haxo ix yilan ix Noemí chi' to ay wal och t'a sk'ol ix Rut chi' sb'at yet'ok, manhxalaj tas ix yal ix t'a ix.

Ix b'eyxikot heb' ix schawanhil, masanto ix jawi heb' ix t'a Belén. Ayik ix jawi heb' ix ta', masanil heb' anima ay ta' ix te sat sk'ol heb'. Ix yalan heb' ix ix icha tik: --¿Mantok a ix Noemí tik? xchi heb' ix.
Yuj chi' ix tak'wi ix t'a heb' ix icha tik: --Manhxo eyal Noemí t'ayin, palta Mara tzeyak' in b'iej, yujto ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ha' ix ak'an in yaelal.

Ayik ix in b'at t'a tik, manh jantakok tas ay t'ayin, haxo yik tzin meltzaj tik, manhxalaj jab'ok. Icha chi' ix el t'a sk'ool Jehová sjawi t'a wib'anh, ¿tasto wal yuj tzeyal Noemí chi' t'ayin yujto toxo ix ja t'a wib'anh wab'an syail yuj Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil? xchi ix.
Ichaton chi' ix aj sjawi ix Noemí yet' ix Rut t'a Belén chi', spetoj heb' ix t'a yol yik Moab. Ha ix jawi heb' ix chi', wan wal syamchajoch sjochchaj ixim cebada.
